title: Bounded approximation in uniformly discrete Lipschitz-free spaces
exact_target: If a pointed metric space M is uniformly discrete and its real Lipschitz-free Banach space has the approximation property, must that free space have the bounded approximation property for some finite constant?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
